31:["$","p",null,{"children":["Pages with a large amount of v1.2-only state (quotas, domains, groups, invites,\nsettings) are shared through Askama macros in ",["$","code",null,{"children":"templates/content/"}],". A theme\noverrides the chrome and the public/auth pages from its original design, and\nwraps the shared body in its own shell. This keeps every theme feature-complete\nwhen the product grows, at the cost of the older designs looking more like the\nbase content on dense admin pages. 36:["$","p",null,{"children":["The policy is enforced when pages render, not only by hiding the picker. Under\n",["$","strong",null,{"children":"Administrators only"}],", non-admin accounts and anonymous visitors always render\nthe site default; an existing ",["$","code",null,{"children":"urlet_theme"}]," cookie (including one set while the\npolicy was ",["$","code",null,{"children":"Everyone"}],") is ignored. 3b:["$","p",null,{"children":["The content hash is part of ",["$","code",null,{"children":"/assets/custom-themes/{key}?v=<hash>"}],", so replacing\na stylesheet changes the URL and cannot be masked by the one-hour asset cache.\nThe metadata and the file live on the persistent ",["$","code",null,{"children":"/data"}]," volume; a restart\nrebuilds the in-memory registry from the database and the upload remains\nselectable."]}]
3c:["$","p",null,{"children":"The upload is deliberately restricted:"}]
3d:["$","ul",null,{"children":["\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["a CSS file: the upload field expects one; ",["$","code",null,{"children":"accept=\".css,text/css\""}]," and the\ndrop zone's filename check are browser-side conveniences, and the server never\nlooks at the extension. Validation runs on the content: UTF-8, 256 KiB at\nmost, no control characters, and at least one ",["$","code",null,{"children":"{"}]," and one ",["$","code",null,{"children":"}"}],";"]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":"at most 32 custom themes per instance;"}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["absolute external references and cross-origin ",["$","code",null,{"children":"url(...)"}]," are rejected:\n",["$","code",null,{"children":"http://"}],", ",["$","code",null,{"children":"https://"}],", ",["$","code",null,{"children":"ftp://"}],", ",["$","code",null,{"children":"data:text/html"}]," and ",["$","code",null,{"children":"data:image/svg"}]," are\nrefused anywhere in the file, and a ",["$","code",null,{"children":"url(...)"}]," may not point at another origin.\nCSS escapes and comments are decoded first, so ",["$","code",null,{"children":"u\\72l("}]," cannot smuggle one\npast. The scan matches text rather than parsing CSS, so a protocol-relative\nreference inside another functional notation — ",["$","code",null,{"children":"image-set(\"//host/a.png\")"}],",\nfor example — is not caught; the CSP is the second line of defence;"]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["no ",["$","code",null,{"children":"@import"}],", ",["$","code",null,{"children":"expression(...)"}]," or legacy ",["$","code",null,{"children":"behavior"}],";"]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["served as ",["$","code",null,{"children":"text/css"}]," with ",["$","code",null,{"children":"X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff"}],", so it cannot turn\ninto an HTML document."]}],"\n"]}]
3e:["$","p",null,{"children":"An upload also chooses how the palette behaves:"}]
3f:["$","ul",null,{"children":["\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Follow system"}]," keeps the ordinary light/dark control and follows the\noperating system until the visitor picks a mode."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Light only"}]," and ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"Dark only"}]," force ",["$","code",null,{"children":"data-theme=\"light\""}],"/",["$","code",null,{"children":"\"dark\""}]," on the\nserver, hide the light/dark control, and cannot be overridden by a saved\nbrowser preference. 43:["$","$L45",null,{"as":"h2","id":"deliberate-limits","children":"Deliberate limits"}]
44:["$","ul",null,{"children":["\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["Uploads are stylesheets, not templates. The CSP stays ",["$","code",null,{"children":"default-src 'self'"}]," and\nthe binary stays self-contained; a custom theme cannot add markup or scripts."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":"Uploads are administrator-only. There is no per-user theme marketplace or\nper-account upload quota; the site-wide catalogue stays the single source of\ntruth."}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["No remote theme fetch: the server never downloads a stylesheet, and external\n",["$","code",null,{"children":"url(...)"}]," / ",["$","code",null,{"children":"@import"}]," are rejected in addition to being blocked by the CSP."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":["No fine-grained per-account permission: the policy is site-wide (",["$","code",null,{"children":"all"}]," or\n",["$","code",null,{"children":"admin"}],"). The existing user-group feature toggles cover per-group data\ncapabilities, not cosmetics."]}],"\n",["$","li",null,{"children":"Every design except Aurora ships both palettes and the same persisted\nlight/dark control; the control is a cosmetic preference, so it never needs a\nper-account column. Aurora is dark-only by design and has no light palette to\noffer, so it hides the control instead of shipping a dead one."}],"\n"]}]
